verdict: Yes, if you know sarees and can source well. Deeva pitched an online saree platform on Shark Tank India Season 3 and got a deal from three sharks. Sarees are a large and steady market, and online selling reaches buyers far beyond local shops.
angle: Buyers look for handloom, silk and designer sarees for weddings and festivals. Surat, Varanasi, Kanchipuram and Bhagalpur supply different types. Live selling and WhatsApp catalogues work well. Sarees are free-size, which means very few returns for fit.
